success.title: Proposal Submitted!
success.subtitle: Thanks for applying. Our team will review your application and contact you within 5–7 business days.

items.q: How long does the proposal review take?
items.a: Our team reviews proposals within 5–7 business days. If approved, we will contact you to discuss the contract and implementation.

items.q: Can I change my sponsorship tier mid-period?
items.a: Yes, sponsors can upgrade at any time. Downgrades take effect at the next renewal. Our account team will assist with the transition.

items.q: How does the sponsor analytics dashboard work?
items.a: Once activated, you receive access to a dedicated dashboard with metrics such as logo traffic, co-branded content engagement, and SDG impact reports. Accessible 24/7 via the sponsor portal.

items.q: Is there a minimum commitment period?
items.a: Yes, all tiers have a minimum 12-month commitment. This allows us to plan branding integration and measure impact meaningfully.

items.q: What if our organisation is based outside Indonesia?
items.a: We welcome sponsors from around the world. The Wizdam platform is accessed globally, so your partnership has international reach.
We guarantee 99.5% uptime with a written SLA for Platinum and Gold tiers. If downtime affects sponsor visibility, we compensate via extended period or service credit.
